Name: Yet Another Crystal Path Recolor
Author: Lavendarjosh
Description:
[b]I know there's already three other mods that do something similar, but I wasn't 100% satisfied with them, so I made my own.[/b]

[size=4]Three variants to choose from:[/size][b] ﻿[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fOT5GMv.png[/img]

[b]Simply choose the one you want to use, rename it to Flooring.xnb and drag it into the *\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\TerrainFeatures folder (the example png's are not needed).
Make sure to backup your old Flooring.xnb in case you want to go back to vanilla![/b]
